text:
Maya: Quick sync — Aerochip wants a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark for listing on their cloud marketplace and for our SI partners. Looking to align scope and ship a reproducible runbook.
AJ: 👍 do we have dates from Aerochip for the lab window?
Maya: They proposed Jan 9–13 for thermal chamber + kernel tune window. They can also provide 3 x prototype boards for instrumentation.
kevin: Need to confirm hardware SKUs and firmware hashes. Also any kernel patches must be pinned in the runbook.
Aerochip-eng: aerochip-eng: Confirmed SKUs: AC-XL320 (revB), AC-XL320 (revC). Firmware: v2025.08. We can dropboard on Jan 9. We will provide power rail logs and telemetry agent.
Sophia: For Redwood, primary goals: 1) perf/W curve for 4k/8k seq, 2) stable throughput at target p50 latency <= 150ms for batch=1, 3) recommended kernel flags that reduce tail P99.
Dmitri: Also add quantization profile tests: FP16, int8-qat, int8-ptq. We need to capture accuracy delta vs baseline on eval prompts.
Maya: Good call. IaC: can we reuse the bench cluster config from the last NovaEdge run? If so we avoid re-provisioning.
kevin: We can reuse the cluster but need a different NIC tuning and IRQ-affinity config. I'll add the exact sysctl knobs.
AJ: Action item: kevin to send sysctl+irq script by EOD Fri. Sophia to prepare eval prompt set (50 prompts across completion, chat, retrieval). Dmitri to prepare quantization harness. Aerochip-eng to confirm dropboard logistics and telemetry endpoints. Maya to draft runbook skeleton and PR the repo.
Aerochip-eng: Noted. We'll also want a co-announcement. Who handles partner quote/planning?
Maya: Marketing will coordinate. @release-bot can you create a draft checklist for announcement approvals?
release-bot: release-bot: Created checklist: /releases/partners/aerochip-1798765410/checklist — items: bench artifacts, telemetry archive, partner quote, compliance signoff, filing for NDA redactions.
kevin: For reproducibility, suggest recording the exact kernel commit + modprobe list. Example snippet to run on node:
```bash
# capture kernel + modules
uname -a > /tmp/bench-env.txt
git rev-parse HEAD >> /tmp/bench-env.txt  # repo for runtime
lsmod | grep nvgpu >> /tmp/bench-env.txt
# bench command
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-gpt-13b --seq 8192 --batch 1 --steps 200 --profile /tmp/profile.json
```
Sophia: Also we should record ambient temp and thermal throttling events (therm_log). Partner telemetry should include per-GPU power and board temps at 1s intervals.
Aerochip-eng: We'll stream telemetry to s3://aerochip-redwood/jan9-run-raw/ in CSV format and share read-only creds.
Dmitri: For accuracy gating, we will compute ROUGE-L & perplexity on the eval set. If int8 delta > 2% ROUGE-L we mark as fail.
AJ: Who's owning the marketplace listing spec? It needs Table: throughput @ 4k/8k, perf/W plots, supported quant modes, validated infra, and reference deployment template for SIs.
Maya: That will be on me and marketing. I'll draft the marketplace blurb and a technical appendix.
kevin: Kernel tuning notes draft: IRQ affinity to CPUs 2-7, svbus disable on idle, set net.core.rmem_max=134217728. I'll push as kevin/aid/irq-tuning branch.
Sophia: Let's also run a short smoke with 1/10th of the steps in our pre-prod to catch infra regressions before main run.
Aerochip-eng: We can do a dry-run Jan 7 with two boards for smoke.
Maya: Tentative timeline: Jan 7 dry-run; Jan 9 kernel tune + perf runs; Jan 11 quant/accuracy; Jan 12 telem archive + post-analysis; Jan 13 writeup + marketing sync.
Dmitri: Reporting format: CSV artifacts + a single consolidated JSON summary with fields: model, sku, seq_len, batch, throughput_tokens_per_sec, avg_watt, perf_per_watt, p50_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, quant_mode, accuracy_delta. I'll draft schema.
AJ: Perf regression alert: if any run shows p50 > 1.5x baseline, we rollback kernel changes and mark for debug.
kevin: Will prepare a lightweight debug script to collect kgdb+perf-map if that happens.
Sophia: For SI integration, we'll prepare a Terraform module showing how to deploy the optimized kernel + runtime on partner infra; include notes about recommended autoscale thresholds.
Aerochip-eng: Our bizdev asked if we can include a co-branded badge on the marketplace UI: "Validated on Aerochip AC-XL320" — is that okay?
Maya: Yes, marketing to approve badge copy, legal to sign off on co-brand.
release-bot: release-bot: Reminder: schedule a joint exec briefing if PR passes. Placeholder meeting created for Jan 15.
kevin: Sending sysctl/IRQ script now: https://stash.redwood.ai/kevin/irq-tuning/commit/1a2b3c
Maya: Thanks all. I'll PR the runbook skeleton today: repo: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-benchmarks/pulls.
AJ: Quick note — please keep logs small: gzip telemetry and upload checksums.
Dmitri: I'll add checksums and a simple validation script that verifies CSV schema and a sample perf/W calc.
Sophia: One more ask: include raw outputs for the model's token breakdown so we can reproduce latency spikes (KV cache metrics).
Aerochip-eng: Will add token-level telemetry on request.
Maya: Great. Next sync Friday 10am PT. If anything blocks before then ping me. :rocket:
